summary: Single-track, quick-difficulty plan for a well-scoped, recon-confirmed bug. Method: orchestrator self-audit rather than a full plan-auditor dispatch (rig-run plan_audit microflow tunnel is down; item is low-risk/mechanical per the routing table's plan-auditor override). Self-audit found and corrected one real gap before this PASS: the initial planner draft did not survey all call sites of the function being modified (_langevin_settle_vel has 5 call sites, not 1), which would have risked a breaking change to 3 unrelated integrators. Corrected in .praxia/plans.jsonl by requiring a safe False default on the modified function and confining the True-default threading to only the two CSVR call sites.

dependency_ordering.notes: survey-all-call-sites now explicitly ordered before any edit; test after implementation; commit last

verification_design.notes: 8-item VERIFY checklist including an explicit check that the 3 untouched call sites show zero diff -- directly guards against the gap this audit found

risk_mitigation.notes: safe-default correction closes the main risk found; residual risk is whether the new test can actually reproduce the pre-fix divergence at local-smoke scale within a reasonable runtime -- fixer_prompt explicitly permits an honest partial-improvement outcome instead of forcing a full-resolution claim

completeness.notes: covers survey, implementation at the right layer with the right default, regression test, single-file test run, commit

findings.issue: initial planner draft would have added a required-seeming new parameter to a 5-call-site shared function without specifying a safe default, risking silent breakage of 3 unrelated integrators (settle_langevin, settle_lfmiddle, settle_with_nhc-adjacent paths)
findings.fix: corrected: default False on _langevin_settle_vel itself; True only threaded explicitly at the two CSVR call sites

suggestions: fixer should independently confirm which specific outer function owns each of the 5 call sites before editing, per step 1 -- do not assume the line-order mapping to settle_langevin/settle_lfmiddle/settle_with_nhc/settle_csvr/settle_csvr_npt is exact without checking
